definitions.explanation: Without covering or protection; figuratively, without pretense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{裸|はだか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧{裸|はだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I undressed to take a bath.
examples.notes: {裸|はだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ = to undress, to get naked

examples.english: At hot springs, you bathe naked together with strangers.

examples.japanese: {裸|はだか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}めた→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
examples.english: We deepened our friendship through frank, open interaction.
examples.notes: {裸|はだか}の⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ = honest, open relationship (lit. 'naked association')

examples.english: Bare trees stand against the winter sky.

examples.japanese: {裸|はだか}⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦ぶら{下|さ}がっている→ぶら下がる：05541_burasagaru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was a room with only a single bare light bulb hanging.
examples.notes: {裸|はだか}⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧ = bare/unshaded light bulb

notes:
Can be used literally (without clothes) or figuratively (exposed, honest, bare).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {裸|はだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become naked, to strip down)
- {裸|はだか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ (frank, heart-to-heart relationship)
- {裸一貫|はだかいっかん} (starting with nothing but oneself)
- {裸|はだか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧ (The Emperor's New Clothes)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{裸足|はだし}→裸足：17169_hadashi⟧ (barefoot)
- ⟦{裸眼|らがん}→裸眼：20622_ragan⟧ (naked eye, without glasses)
- {素裸|すっぱだか} (stark naked — emphatic)
